title: PJTSAU Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Project Assistant and Field Assistant Posts
description: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 02 Project Assistant and Field Assistant Jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application.
